In a world where everyone takes wonders like magic spells and dragons for granted, Coco is a girl with a simple dream: She wants to be a witch. But everybody knows magicians are born, not made, and Coco was not born with a gift for magic. Resigned to her un-magical life, Coco is about to give up on her dream to become a witch until the day she meets Qifrey, a mysterious, traveling magician. After secretly seeing Qifrey perform magic in a way she’s never seen before, Coco soon learns what everybody “knows” might not be the truth, and discovers that her magical dream may not be as far away as it may seem.

Won Best U.S. Edition of International Material - Asia, together with [Cats of the Louvre](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=21543597287) at the Eisner Awards in 2020 and won Best Manga at the Harvey Awards in 2020. {"total_hits":10000,"page":1,"per_page":10,"results":[{"record":{"series_id":26643241978,"title":"Tongari Boushi no Atelier","url":"https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/c8mp52y/tongari-boushi-no-atelier","description":"From Kodansha:  
In a world where everyone takes wonders like magic spells and dragons for granted, Coco is a girl with a simple dream: She wants to be a witch. But everybody knows magicians are born, not made, and Coco was not born with a gift for magic. Resigned to her un-magical life, Coco is about to give up on her dream to become a witch until the day she meets Qifrey, a mysterious, traveling magician. After secretly seeing Qifrey perform magic in a way she’s never seen before, Coco soon learns what everybody “knows” might not be the truth, and discovers that her magical dream may not be as far away as it may seem.

**Original Manga:** [Comic Days](https://comic-days.com/episode/13932016480031217072), [Morning](https://morning.kodansha.co.jp/c/tongariboushi/), [Pocket Magazine](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/title/01683/episode/343238) 

**Official English Release:** [Comic DAYS](https://comic-days.com/episode/3270375685330852748),  [Coolmic](https://coolmic.me/titles/5873), [K Manga](https://kmanga.kodansha.com/title/10065/episode/313463), [Kodansha](https://kodansha.us/series/witch-hat-atelier/), [Mangaplaza](https://mangaplaza.com/title/0303007358/), [OMOI](https://www.omoi.com/series/witch-hat-atelier), [Renta!](https://www.ebookrenta.com/renta/sc/frm/item/147712)

##### Notes: Won Best Seinen at 24th Manga Barcelona Awards in 2018. Nominated Best Youth Comic at Angoulême International Comics Festival in 2019. Won Next Manga at Ridibooks Comic Award, won Daruma d'or Manga at Japan Expo Awards, won Best Seinen Manga at Mangawa Prize and won Grand Prize at Les Mordus du Manga Award in 2019. Won Best U.S. Edition of International Material - Asia, together with [Cats of the Louvre](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=21543597287) at the Eisner Awards in 2020 and won Best Manga at the Harvey Awards in 2020. Won Best Seinen at 28th Manga Barcelona Awards in 2022, at 29th Manga Barcelona Awards in 2023. Nominated for the 11th Manga Taishou Award in 2018 and the Harvey Award for Best Manga in 2024. In a world devastated by humankind and forsaken by plants and animals, only witches have the power to communicate with nature.

A long time ago, plants and animals lived in harmony… until humankind came to power and, unable to coexist with nature, destroyed and exploited both flora and fauna without a second thought. Blamed for the extinction of plant life, and feared by humanity for their powers, they hide away from the rest of humanity in secret lairs bursting with greenery.

Pili, a young witch-apprentice, has set out on the roads accompanied by the wolf Oak. However, she is not accustomed to the world outside and traveling long distances. Her fatigue quickly takes its toll, and she ends up injuring herself by tumbling down a rocky slope! Fortunately, a boy named Bowei finds Pili and takes her home to nurse her back to health.

However, the arrival of the unfamiliar young lady arouses suspicion among other villagers, who quickly discern her true nature as a witch. And all captured witches share the fate of execution!
